attorneys: Petitioner pro se., Thomas B. Finan, Attorney General of Maryland, and Robert F. Sweeney, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text: Motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Court of Appeals of Maryland granted limited to the point of law raised in Hamilton v. Alabama, 368 U. S. 52. Case transferred to the appellate docket.
